title: From vision to a place to call home.
subtitle: A waterfront tower concept, explored through one clear route.
alt: Generated waterfront tower concept with a landscaped approach and bronze entrance canopy

chapters.title: Build to opening
chapters.summary: A locked-camera construction timelapse resolves into the completed tower and opening day.
chapters.continuity: Same tower silhouette, footprint, shoreline and approach. Do not morph a different building into the final structure.

chapters.title: Landscape & arrival
chapters.summary: Follow the stone approach past the reflecting pool and through the bronze entrance canopy.
chapters.continuity: Keep the pool on the left of the walking line; the bronze portal stays directly ahead. End at the inner entrance threshold.

chapters.title: Lobby & lift
chapters.summary: Move through the lobby, then turn toward the lift bank on the right.
chapters.continuity: Repeat entrance fins, limestone floor and pool sightline. Follow an unobstructed floor path; no camera passing through furniture or walls.

chapters.title: Residence & view
chapters.summary: Use a matched lift-door cut to the residential floor, then enter a living space and reveal the waterfront view.
chapters.continuity: A clear editorial cut bridges lift travel. Keep door material, corridor direction, daylight and waterfront orientation consistent. This is a conceptual route, not a measured floor plan.

title: Arrive. Unwind. Feel at home.
subtitle: A brief guest journey from the lobby to a quiet suite.
alt: Generated boutique hotel lobby with limestone reception, seafoam seating and a bronze lift bank to the right

chapters.title: Lobby & arrival
chapters.summary: Enter the lobby, pass reception and turn right toward the bronze lift bank.
chapters.continuity: Pale limestone, oak ceiling fins, seafoam seating and the courtyard tree stay in their reference positions. Keep the guest walking line clear.

chapters.title: Suite & terrace
chapters.summary: A matched-door cut leads into the suite, then a short reveal opens toward its terrace.
chapters.continuity: Continue the same limestone, oak and bronze palette. The corridor leads naturally through one room door; keep the bed, window and terrace fixed throughout the shot.
